summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests spevatamig (PT886), a bispecific antibody that targets CLDN18.2 and CD47, alone or with chemotherapy, targeted therapy, or an immune checkpoint inhibitor, in advanced gastric, gastroesophageal junction, pancreatic, biliary tract, and colorectal cancers. The route of administration and dosing schedule are not stated in the record. The study measures safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and preliminary efficacy.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa spevatamig (PT886), un anticuerpo biespecífico que se dirige a CLDN18.2 y CD47, solo o combinado con quimioterapia, terapia dirigida o un inhibidor de punto de control inmunitario, en cáncer gástrico avanzado, de la unión gastroesofágica, pancreático, de vías biliares y colorrectal. La vía de administración y el esquema de dosis no se indican en el registro. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética, la farmacodinamia y la eficacia preliminar.
who_for: Age 18 or older, able to sign consent and follow the protocol.
Measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 criteria.
Unresectable or metastatic gastric, gastroesophageal junction, pancreatic, or biliary tract cancer, or colorectal cancer in some parts, depending on the part an

not_for: Women who could become pregnant and do not use adequate birth control.
Active autoimmune disease that needed systemic treatment in the past 2 years.
Prior CLDN18.2 or CD47 targeting therapy, or SIRPα targeting agents.
